evidence: Workbook Quality Checks!D51 excludes scratch/build residue/caches, and frozen staged-task-contract.md:32 explicitly says node_modules must be absent. An actual full filesystem enumeration of the frozen task found 1,384 files: 43 outside node_modules and 1,341 files totaling 58,215,036 bytes inside solution/app/node_modules, plus an empty .vite-temp directory. These include node_modules/.package-lock.json (SHA256 98b54d7b67ce87528211592c8c925c77dbdcf35dd957994db0aaf0faae3a3a98), @esbuild/win32-x64/esbuild.exe (SHA256 cae1bbc86f4df800b01d99e28aea0a154b02243de6797e98f48a9b88a64a7be0), and @rollup/rollup-win32-x64-msvc/rollup.win32-x64-msvc.node (SHA256 3501fda4eb7a65644e019637ea3bfac493c861891fcd12aabca013d671e61c93; MZ/PE signature). The esbuild package.json:14-18 and Rollup package.json:4-8 explicitly select win32/x64. solution/solve.sh:38 copies the entire source_app tree into /app, so the residue is not filtered during installation. All required closed-list files were present, six operating notes existed, and no unexpected task-root or tests-root entries were found. The 43 legitimate files include the actual public assets served by server.js:130-131; those are deliverable app files, not stray scratch output. The workbook/skill exception for seed_data.json and coverage.json does not excuse node_modules. raw-evidence-index.json:40 separately states scripted proofs omitted the frozen Windows dependencies; its SHA256 is c5fb62b99ab425667d2346c5475436eaffa42d2f77d389d387edec1f3d3209b8, and all 21 artifact hashes matched. This row is confirmed by direct filesystem inspection; no private checker, Linux startup of the exact copied tree, configured judge, Oracle or portal result is claimed.
counterexample: The actual frozen golden tree is a concrete disallowed package: its Windows dependency cache can be missed by default ignored-file search, while selective scripted deployment of server.js/public can pass without ever installing that tree. Shipping via solve.sh copies the cache into the Linux app and can shadow image-provided dependencies; the exact runtime consequence was not measured here. Conversely, a conforming golden with pinned package manifests and its served public/assets bundle but no node_modules must remain acceptable: classifying every compiled browser asset as prohibited build residue would incorrectly reject the runtime deliverable.
suggested_fix: Remove local node_modules and its caches from the source candidate using the authorized bounded cleanup process, preserve the served app bundle and manifests, then create a new frozen candidate and verify the exact packaged inventory and Linux installation before clearance.
